title: Crosschain Dapps
tagline: A truely trustless crosschain interaction that can also be used as a bridge
description: Crosschain Dapps is an infrastructure project expanding the conecpt of what was accomplished in ETH Waterloo, Luban the Paymaster. This project uses the infra of Hyperlane V3 deployments to act as an calldata forwarding through the postop payamster command. This allows for endless opportunities to execute direct calldata or directly interacting with a frontend dapp.
how_its_made:
The project is created by implementing several components.
Hyperlane V3 validator, relay node, mailbox
Worker for processing aa bundle interactions
Escrow and paymaster contracts on both chains
Frontend test of the application
Python API for formulating the userop
Web3Auth for social login and signing method
